name: The Antikythera Sky Map
description: An ancient celestial map projected onto a mountain plateau, its stone carvings glow with constellations, and a mechanical sun circles above, casting dynamic shadows.
prompt: An ancient Antikythera Sky Map carved into a massive mountain plateau: stone reliefs of constellations glowing with soft blue light, a mechanical sun orbiting above, casting shifting shadows across the landscape, dramatic lighting, ultra‑detailed, epic fantasy terrain.
caption: Explore the Antikythera Sky Map—where stone and mechanism unite to chart the heavens ✨⭐.
